response.sql: WITH by_source AS (SELECT p.fundflux, COUNT(*) as size, AVG(CASE WHEN sp.boxy IS NOT NULL AND sp.boxz IS NOT NULL THEN sp.boxy / sp.boxz ELSE NULL END) as avg_ratio FROM scanspatial sp JOIN projects p ON sp.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux), avg_size_calc AS (SELECT AVG(size) as average_size FROM by_source), above_avg AS (SELECT bs.size, bs.avg_ratio, asc.average_size FROM by_source bs, avg_size_calc asc WHERE bs.size > asc.average_size) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as avg_of_ratios, SUM(size) as combined_size, AVG(size - average_size) as avg_excess FROM above_avg
